about.heading: A working coach.
paragraphs: Peter coaches at the Philadelphia Union Academy. He started as a grassroots coach in Ireland, then came to the US for a master's degree and a college coaching role at the University of Maine. He's coached at every level of the American game since, from grassroots through to MLS academy.
Peter believes player development happens at training, not in matches. The way a session runs, the feedback a player gets, the day-to-day standard. That's the level where the work matters most.
